title: Free Ground Shipping Floor by Subscription Age (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Rate note.** The free-shipping floor a self-pay ground shipment's value is tested against in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program depends on how long ago the subscription was opened:

| Whole calendar months from the enrollment date to the handling day | Free-shipping floor |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 100.00 |
| 12 to 23 | 85.00 |
| 24 or more | no floor set by this note |

A shipment whose value reaches the floor (is at or above it) owes no ground charge.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Subscription opened 11 whole months ago, shipment value 99.99: below the 100.00 floor.
- Opened 11 whole months ago, value 100.00: reaches the floor.
- Opened 12 whole months ago, value 90.00: reaches the 85.00 floor.
- Opened 23 whole months ago, value 84.99: below the 85.00 floor.
